title: hypolepis paupercula
intro: Hypolepis paupercula, commonly known as the Poor Fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Dennstaedtiaceae. The Poor Fern has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever reduction, respiratory problems, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as acting as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Hypolepis paupercula include its ability to soothe and calm the body, as well as its antiseptic properties, which can help to prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of the Poor Fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
